CP0.title: Static Syntax & Smoke Suite
steps: Confirm py_compile and node --check on embedded JS both pass with 0 errors.
fail: Any syntax error, JS parse failure, or smoke test assertion failure.

CP1.title: Transcript Discovery & Live State Accuracy
steps: Verify /api/sessions lists recent Antigravity brain sessions.
Verify /api/state parses root coordinator, spawned subagents, unquoted args, and live THINKING/WORKING/DONE states.
pass: Dynamic agent discovery works with zero hardcoded project names.
Self-daemon rows are excluded from WORKING detection.
fail: Missing subagents, quoted arg artifacts, or stuck WORKING/THINKING status.

CP2.title: SSE Streaming & Video Timeline Scrubbing
steps: Open the live UI on an ephemeral or default port and verify /api/stream connects.
Scrub timeline backward, verify buildSnapshot historical reconstruction, hover preview, and LIVE tail re-pinning.
pass: Zero console errors, non-overlapping SVG topology for 1-12+ agents, smooth timeline scrubbing and keyboard shortcuts (Space, Left/Right, Home, L).
fail: Broken SSE reconnects, overlapping SVG nodes, or broken timeline snapshot state.
